text.tspan: every real commit from Sera's repo, one circle at a time
Turquoise ring: more insertions than deletions
Pink ring: more deletions than insertions
Dark blue circle: as many insertions as deletions
Small yellow circle: commit with no file changed
A hexagon is an automated commit
hover a commit for its details, or an author's mark to rescale the margins to their own activity
seraplot · regenerated automatically every week from Sera's git history
